descripcion: Selectable per-app Force Dark theme enabler for Android 10+ using Shizuku or Root. Features an LSPosed/Xposed module to bypass app-level dark mode blocks, automated sunrise/sunset scheduling, and automation broadcasts (Tasker/MacroDroid).
